sentences.text: Pooja Brahmi & Ors vs Unknown on 11 December, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
11.12.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.175 Crr No.4055 of 2024 In the matter of : Pooja Brahmi & Ors.
.......Petitioners Mr. Prabir Kumar Mitra Mr. Pinak Kumar Mitra Mr. Sananda Bhattacharjee ...for
the Petitioners

The 1st petitioner is the erstwhile daughter-in-law of the opposite party and the 2nd
and 3rd petitioners are her parents.

The petitioners seek quashing of Complaint Case No. C-231 of 2024 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 10th Court, Alipore, 24-Parganas primarily on the ground that the provision laid down under Section 202 of the Code of Criminal Procedure was not complied with by the learned Magistrate prior to issuance of process against them.
The petitioners are residents of Gurugram, Haryana.
Marriage between the 1st petitioner and her husband was declared null and void under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act by the Family Court at Gurugram, Haryana.
The 1 st petitioner lodged complaint under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code before the Delhi Court against the complainant and others wherein charge sheet has been submitted and charges framed.
An application under The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act filed by the petitioner is also pending.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As a retaliation, the present complaint has been lodged against the petitioners on false and frivolous grounds.
It appears from the materials on record that matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite party and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of March,2025.

Further proceedings of Complaint Case No. C-231 of 2024 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 10th Court, Alipore, 24-Parganas be stayed till March 31, 2025 or until further orders,
whichever is earlier.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Suvra Ghosh,J)
